newsitem.title: UK: Tennis-Rain threatens third day at Wimbledon.
newsitem.headline: Tennis-Rain threatens third day at Wimbledon.

text.p: Rain threatened to disrupt the third day's play at Wimbledon on Wednesday.
Forecasters said there was a 60 percent chance of rain, some of it heavy, although there were hopes of brighter spells later in the day.
Showers spoiled Monday's opening day but there was a full day's play on Tuesday.
Defending champion Richard Krajicek was due on Court Two at 1100 GMT on Wednesday in a second round match against Romania's Andrei Pavel.
British fans were hoping to see their favourites Tim Henman and Greg Rusedski in second round action later in the day.
The forecast for later in the week was cool, windy and some more rain.
